## Changes

- Add Mandarin Chinese, Arabic, Tagalog, and Vietnamese on-device subtitles for RSS podcasts.
- Choose Tiny or Small for English, German, Spanish, and Japanese from one model setting per language. Existing models and completed same-language subtitles are kept when switching.
- On Android 11 or newer, show available system exit reasons after interrupted recognition. Offer Tiny when Android confirms memory pressure while Small was in use.
- Fix subtitle position flicker while recognition fills earlier sections of an episode.
- Let the playing RSS episode buffer further ahead within the audio memory budget.
- Fix opening Apple News Today and playing its official public RSS episodes.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device. On-device recognition remains experimental. Exit diagnostics depend on system records; an unknown exit is not classified as low memory. Tiny uses fewer resources but can be less accurate than Small.

## 更新内容

- RSS 播客端侧字幕新增普通话、阿拉伯语、他加禄语和越南语。
- 英语、德语、西班牙语和日语可选 Tiny 或 Small，每种语言共用一个模型设置入口。切换后保留已有模型和同语种已完成的字幕。
- Android 11 及以上可在识别异常退出后查看系统提供的原因；确认使用 Small 时因内存压力退出，会提供 Tiny 选择入口。
- 修复回头识别前段音频时，正在播放的字幕位置闪回的问题。
- RSS 播客可预读更长的音频，同时限制内存占用。
- 修复 Apple News Today 无法打开详情及播放官方公开 RSS 单集的问题。

需要 Android 8.0 或更新系统，以及 ARM64 设备。端侧识别仍为实验性功能。退出诊断依赖系统记录，原因未明的退出不会被判为内存不足。Tiny 资源占用较低，识别准确度可能低于 Small。
